platform: Arch Linux, Omarchy 4.5.0-3, Hyprland 0.56.2, Quickshell 0.3.2 (r7), Node.js 22.23.3. A desktop with three 1920x1200 monitors (two at scale 1.6, one at scale 1), bar at the top, as a viewer of the main machine. cronward from its main branch at 44efc1a (2026-11-15), which is in cronward v0.2.0. Also this laptop (Omarchy 4.5.0-3, one 2560x1600 monitor at scale 2), a viewer of the same main machine, for the demo states that press keys.
commands: ./tests/run, on the desktop and on the laptop
omarchy plugin add (README Install), then omarchy plugin update io.github.frestina.cronward and omarchy restart shell, on the desktop
omarchy bar set io.github.frestina.cronward host <main machine>, on the desktop
On the desktop: demo/run "0,0 4320x760" mixed unreachable timeout check-timeout workflows-list workflows-timeout
On the laptop: demo/run "600,0 680x440" didnt-run workflows-list timeout workflows-timeout add-timeout action-timeout check-timeout
By hand on the desktop, on real data: Check now, right click, a row's link, Config, Token, Set up with agent, Workflows, Add job, Run now, Remove, Remove account, a theme switch and a vertical bar
Set up with agent on the laptop, with the agent asked to read back the guide's path from its prompt
After the run: VERSION and manifest.json set to 0.2.0 and the README pointed at cronward v0.2.0 (015ec30), then ./tests/run, omarchy plugin validate and the plain-text check again on the laptop
results: Portable checks (80 tests) pass on both machines; the Omarchy validator and the plain-text check pass. shellcheck is not installed on the desktop, so it ran on the laptop only.

Installed on the desktop by following the README: after setting the Main machine, the widget read the status the desktop's cronward viewer fetched, and Workflows listed the main machine's accounts and repos.
Every demo state on the desktop rendered in the theme's colours, the popup opened under the button on the first monitor, the count showed on all three bars, and shell.json was put back byte for byte.

The five no-answer states (status, Check now, Workflows, Add job, Run now) each said who gave no answer and in how long, and the popup did not stay busy. Add job and Run now said the change may have happened anyway, and the status was read again.
Check now moved 'as of' forward; right click opened cronward status in a terminal; a row opened its run on GitHub.

Config, Token and Set up with agent opened a terminal, GitHub's token page and the agent, on the main machine through cronward --on. The agent's prompt named docs/AGENT_SETUP.md in the installed plugin.
Add job on a workflow in a private test repo: the job showed in the jobs after the add, and a refused add showed cronward's reason in the form.
Run now and Remove each asked first; Cancel and Esc did nothing; a yes to Run now showed the row running, and a yes to Remove took the row away.
Remove account was dimmed, with the jobs named, while a job used the account.
A theme switch: the warning and 'on cronward' colours followed the new theme. A vertical bar showed the icon without the count, as designed.
015ec30 changes only the version numbers and the README since e0e1867, the commit tested by hand; the checks pass on it.
limitations: The no-answer states came from the demo's exit 124, not from a real ssh that hung; tests/deadline.test.mjs checks with a fake cronward that nothing is left running at the deadline or after a SIGTERM.
Not tried: a shell restart while a call runs. If Quickshell kills timeout with SIGKILL, only cronward's own limits (Frestina/cronward#51) stop its ssh.

The demo states that press keys (the add form, Run now, Remove, Remove account) were captured on the laptop only, so no key could reach another window on the desktop. On the desktop these buttons were used by hand.
Ask agent (on a failed or didn't-run job) was not clicked in this run; it was in the v0.1.0 acceptance.
The account key button has still only been seen, not clicked, against a real missing or expiring token.
Not yet tried on the main machine itself (host blank) with a real cronward.
Omarchy 4.0.6 was tested with v0.1.0 only.
